dataset.paired: Same strip before and after 60 min; preserve IDs and tuber blocks A–D
dataset.randomization: One strip per tuber assigned to each concentration, randomized within block
dataset.controls: 22°C; 60 min; 50 mL per cup; nominal 30×10×10 mm; same material batch and blotting method; balance 0.01 g

calculation.formula: 100*(after-before)/before for each strip; arithmetic mean of four percentages
calculation.summary: mean, min, max, n=4; range is not a confidence interval
calculation.limits: No p-values, significance claims, 20-tuber interpretation or 40-independent-sample interpretation

zeroEstimate.method: linear interpolation between positive mean at 0.2 and negative mean at 0.4 mol/L
zeroEstimate.limits: An estimate of external concentration for zero net mass change after 60 min, not exact intracellular sucrose concentration or proof of equilibrium

assumptions: Water-potential differences can drive net water movement
limits: Blotting, tissue damage or solute movement may contribute
Temperature, time and material scope matter
